title: GRIFDIR: Graph Resolution-Invariant Diffusion Models over Irregular Domains
abstract: arXiv:2605.03497v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Score-based diffusion models in infinite-dimensional function spaces provide a mathematically principled framework for modelling function-valued data, offering key advantages such as resolution invariance and the ability to handle irregular discretisations. However, practical implementations have struggled to fully realise these benefits. Existing backbones like Fourier neural operators are often biased towards regular grids and fail to generalise to complex domain topologies. We introduce an architecture, GRIFDIR, for function-space diffusion models that represents generalised graph convolutional kernels as finite element functions, allowing the score network to operate directly on unstructured meshes over domains of arbitrary shape. translated_title: GRIFDIR：不规则域上的图分辨率不变扩散模型
translated_abstract: 无限维函数空间中基于分数的扩散模型为函数值数据建模提供了一个数学上严谨的框架，具有分辨率不变性和处理不规则离散化等关键优势。然而，实际实现往往难以充分发挥这些优势。现有的骨干网络（如傅里叶神经算子）通常偏向于规则网格，无法泛化到复杂的域拓扑结构。我们提出了一种用于函数空间扩散模型的架构 GRIFDIR，它将广义图卷积核表示为有限元函数，使分数网络能够直接在任意形状域的非结构化网格上运行。我们通过一系列涵盖多种几何形状（包括非凸域和多连通域等）的无条件和条件采样实验，验证了所提网络架构的有效性。
tldr: 本文提出GRIFDIR架构，将广义图卷积核表示为有限元函数，使函数空间扩散模型能够直接在任意形状域的非结构化网格上运行，克服了傅里叶神经算子对规则网格的偏向，实现了真正的分辨率不变性。
en_tdlr: GRIFDIR represents generalized graph convolutional kernels as finite element functions, enabling function-space diffusion models to operate directly on unstructured meshes over arbitrarily shaped domains, overcoming the regular-grid bias of Fourier neural operators and achieving true resolution invariance.
